value.rationale: The origin/axis Gaussian sigma-point rule is a standard fully symmetric multivariate quadrature architecture. A known practical high-dimensional sign instability is now classified across all dimensions/radii/kernel and integration widths by a unique exact safe-radius condition, with a sharp sqrt(log d) scaling. Positivity affects meaningful nonnegative-data interpretation and perturbation amplification. The classification is a motivated complete family boundary, not a toy isolated computation; it does not imply minimax accuracy or numerical conditioning.
